sections.title: Hidden Skills
sections.note: Approach the Golden Wolf as a human; the Hero's Shade tests the last skill, then teaches the next. Skills always come in this order.

items.name: Ending Blow
items.area: North Faron Woods, path to the Forest Temple
items.howTo: Perform: knock an enemy down, keep it targeted with L and press A to leap onto it for an instant kill. Learn: the Golden Wolf blocks the path to the Forest Temple; no stone needed.
items.notes: Required: it can't be skipped and the final battle uses it. HD: ZL to target.

items.name: Shield Attack
items.howTo: Perform: while targeting with L, press R to bash with the shield, stunning foes and knocking projectiles back. Learn: howl at the Death Mountain stone, then meet the Golden Wolf at Ordon Spring.
items.notes: Wii: thrust the Nunchuk. HD: ZR.

items.name: Back Slice
items.area: Hyrule Field, platform west of Castle Town
items.howTo: Perform: target with L, hold left or right and press A to side-hop, press A again to roll behind, then B to slash. Learn: after the Upper Zora's River stone, find the wolf on a raised platform outside Castle Town's west gate.
items.notes: On Wii (and HD Hero Mode) this spot is east of Castle Town.

items.name: Helm Splitter
items.area: Hyrule Field south of Castle Town
items.howTo: Perform: Shield Attack an enemy and, while it's stunned, press A to vault over its head and strike from behind. Learn: after the North Faron Woods stone, find the wolf south of Castle Town, west of the stairway.

items.name: Mortal Draw
items.area: Gerudo Desert, northeast, before the Bulblin camp
items.howTo: Perform: with the sword sheathed and nothing targeted, let an enemy come close and press A when Link grips the hilt for an instant kill. Learn: after the Lake Hylia stone, find the wolf in the northeast desert just before the Bulblin camp.

items.name: Jump Strike
items.howTo: Perform: target with L and hold A until the blade glints, then release to leap and slam the ground with a shockwave that hits everything around. Learn: after the Snowpeak stone, meet the wolf in Kakariko Graveyard.

items.name: Great Spin
items.area: Castle Town, road to Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: Perform: at full health, hold B until the light runs up the blade and release for a much larger spin attack. Learn: after the Hidden Village stone, find the wolf on the path from Castle Town's central square up to Hyrule Castle.
items.notes: Wii: shake the Nunchuk at full health.

sections.title: Howling Stones
sections.note: Stand by a stone as a wolf, listen to the tune the wind plays and howl it back; then howl it again as a duet with the Golden Wolf.

items.name: Death Mountain Howling Stone
items.howTo: On the trail up Death Mountain, in the first wide area of rocky platforms and steam geysers.
items.reward: Song of Healing; Golden Wolf appears at Ordon Spring
items.notes: The tune is the Song of Healing (Majora's Mask).

items.name: Upper Zora's River Howling Stone
items.area: Upper Zora's River, northwest of Iza's Boat Rental
items.howTo: On a small cliff overlooking the river, northwest of Iza's cabin.
items.reward: Requiem of Spirit; Golden Wolf appears west of Castle Town
items.notes: Zelda Wiki and the Encyclopedia name the tune the Requiem of Spirit (Ocarina of Time); one GameFAQs guide calls it Oath to Order.

items.name: North Faron Woods Howling Stone
items.area: North Faron Woods, by the way to the Sacred Grove
items.howTo: Past the Forest Temple area, just after the gap with the swinging logs that leads to the Sacred Grove.
items.reward: Prelude of Light; Golden Wolf appears south of Castle Town

items.name: Sacred Grove Howling Stone
items.howTo: The stone marked with the Triforce instead of the Sheikah eye. Howling Zelda's Lullaby here opens the way deeper into the grove, toward the Master Sword.
items.reward: Zelda's Lullaby; opens the path through the grove (no skill)
items.notes: Part of the main quest; it teaches no Hidden Skill.

items.name: Lake Hylia Howling Stone
items.area: Lake Hylia, cliff south of the warp point
items.howTo: On a cliff south of the Lake Hylia warp point near Auru's tower: climb the ladder as a human, then change to a wolf to howl.
items.reward: Unnamed song; Golden Wolf appears in Gerudo Desert
items.notes: The Hyrule Encyclopedia lists the tune as "Unnamed Song 1"; one GameFAQs guide calls it the Nocturne of Shadow.

items.name: Snowpeak Howling Stone
items.howTo: Near the top of the mountain on a ledge overhanging the slope, south of the digging spot that leads into the cave.
items.reward: Unnamed song; Golden Wolf appears in Kakariko Graveyard
items.notes: The Hyrule Encyclopedia lists the tune as "Unnamed Song 2".

items.name: Hidden Village Howling Stone
items.howTo: Behind the building on the west side of the Hidden Village, by the Cucco leader. Don't howl while clearing the Bulblins or during the cat game, or you'll have to start them over.
items.reward: Twilight Princess main theme; Golden Wolf appears on the road to Hyrule Castle
items.notes: The only tune not taken from an older game.
